acceptanceCriteria: Each Core use case has a hostile test set (stale index, dirty worktree, missing anchors, malformed provider records, symlinked or relocated subjects) whose refusals are asserted by tests, and a `hostile-tests` receipt pinned to the test files and revision is retained under conformance/use-cases-v0/receipts/<useCaseId>/.
After the sealed-benchmark and beamfall-dogfood gaps close, a new sealed daily-loop run passes and the three rows move to `verified`; until then they stay `experimental`.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 by decision 0373 item 16 (V1-0011 stays open; the three Core ledger rows are `experimental`, every claim UNPROVEN). No `hostile-tests` receipt exists for UC-TASK-ORIENTATION, UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE or UC-EVIDENCE-CARRYING-COMPLETION; the existing contract and implementation receipts (repositoryRevision 062b0151) carry only the spec and entrypoint subjects. This ticket, the Beamfall dogfood receipt and the two run-001 fixes are the remaining V1-0011 gaps.
title: conformance: produce `hostile-tests` receipts for the three Core use cases
